highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 brings additional Skia m150 reliability fixes to GPU rendering and SkSL.
highlights_body: The servicing update improves failed-flush and resolve handling, prevents stale GPU readbacks, corrects Imagination framebuffer cleanup, and fixes RasterPipeline code generation.

bullets.lead: Ganesh recovers correctly from failed GPU work
bullets.detail: Failed flushes no longer return stale readbacks, dropped resolve tasks restore dirty tracking, and Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion is corrected.

bullets.lead: SkSL RasterPipeline code generation is safer
bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia engine with an upstream fix for a use-after-free during RasterPipeline code generation.

bullets.lead: Additional Skia m150 fixes are included
bullets.detail: Refreshes the bundled release-line engine with a further upstream m150 bug-fix sync.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp advances from 14.2.1.1 to 14.2.1.2 alongside this SkiaSharp servicing release.
